market_risk_policy.purpose: Qualitative monitoring priority. Not a price forecast, discount probability, or automatic purchase command.

priority_order.summary: A published Japan-versus-US listing comparison reported large price differences across some NVIDIA RTX 50-series models, including RTX 5070 and RTX 5070 Ti. The comparison is not an exact-SKU time series for the tracked PNY card and cannot by itself prove a future Japan price increase.
priority_order.decision_rule: Prioritize exact-SKU current price and stock checks; compare vendors only after verifying SKU, stock, freight, and warranty.

priority_order.summary: AKIBA PC Hotline first-half October survey reported Ryzen 7 9700X at JPY 51,800 (+29.6% versus its previous survey) and Ryzen 7 9800X3D at JPY 74,800 (+24.7%). The reading is a dated domestic retail survey, not a guaranteed current price at every shop.
priority_order.decision_rule: Recheck direct offers and calculate the gap versus the Ryzen 7 9700X BF target of JPY 38,000.

priority_order.summary: TrendForce forecast conventional DRAM contract prices +10% to +15% QoQ in 4Q26. Contract prices are not a SKU-specific consumer retail forecast.
priority_order.decision_rule: Track exact 32GB 2x16 kit retail prices, stock and motherboard QVL. Do not buy at a premium solely because of an industry forecast.

priority_order.summary: TrendForce forecast NAND Flash contract prices +15% to +20% QoQ in 4Q26. Retail consumer SSD prices can diverge by product and stock.
priority_order.decision_rule: Track exact Crucial P3 Plus 1TB price and sellable stock. Reject stale or sold-out listing prices as actionable.

priority_order.summary: No sufficient evidence in the cited sources to claim a broad retail price rise for every tracked motherboard, PSU, case, or cooler.
priority_order.decision_rule: Judge from fresh exact-SKU listings, stock, seller and delivered cost, not a generalized claim.

general_rules: Risk priority is qualitative, not numeric probability.
Use multiple same-SKU observations before labeling a trend; preserve retrieval_time and available_at.
A BF target is a desired price, not an expected price or observed deal.
A BF-period actual needs verified retailer-specific 2026 official campaign dates plus exact SKU, price applicability, stock and timestamp.
A risk ranking does not automatically authorize a purchase; require exact live price, inventory, complete configuration, compatibility, return terms and final cash total.
